name: 2027 Reading Tracker Spreadsheet
title: 2027 Reading Tracker Spreadsheet: Book Log, Reading Goal Dashboard, 36-Prompt Reading Challenge & TBR List
etsy_title: 2027 Reading Tracker Spreadsheet, Book Log Template, Reading Challenge, Reading Journal, TBR List & Book Stats, Excel Google Sheets
description:
Log every book you read in 2027, rate it, watch your goal fill up and tick off a 36-prompt reading challenge.

WHAT YOU GET
• Book log for up to 399 books: genre, format, pages, start and finish dates, star rating and favourite quotes
• Dashboard: books and pages read, goal progress bars, average rating and an 'on track?' check
• Books and pages per month, favourite genres with average ratings, and formats (paperback, ebook, audiobook, library)
• Your top 10 highest-rated reads of the year, listed automatically
• 2027 Reading Challenge: 36 prompts that tick themselves off when you finish the book
• TBR list with priority, 'own it?' and where you heard about it; it shows when a book has moved to your log

INSIDE
Start Here guide, Dashboard, Book Log (399 rows), Reading Challenge (36 prompts), TBR List (200 rows), Settings (genres, formats, goals).

FILES
1 Excel file (.xlsx) that also works in Google Sheets (File > Import, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets). Works with Numbers on Mac with basic formatting.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download instantly from your Etsy Purchases page.
2. Open in Excel, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets.
3. Type your numbers in the yellow cells. Everything in green is calculated for you.

PLEASE NOTE
This is a DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Colours may look slightly different on screen and in print.
For use in your own business. Please don't share or resell the file.
Designed by our small studio with the help of digital and AI tools; every page and formula was planned, checked and tested by us.

Questions? Send us a message, we're happy to help.

name: New Year's Eve Party Games 2027
title: New Year's Eve Party Games 2027: Bingo, Trivia, Most Likely To, Would You Rather & 5 More (Printable)
etsy_title: New Years Eve Party Games Printable, NYE Bingo, New Year Trivia, Most Likely To, Would You Rather, 2027 Family Party Game Bundle
description:
Nine printable games to fill the hours until midnight, from bingo and trivia to predictions and a countdown-to-midnight bag for every hour.

WHAT YOU GET
• New Year's Eve Bingo: 24 different cards plus the caller's word squares
• Traditions Around the World trivia: 20 multiple-choice questions with answer key
• Who's Most Likely To… in 2027 (24 cards) and Resolution Would You Rather (24 cards)
• Word scramble (20 words), 2027 Predictions cards and a 'My 2026 in Review' page
• Countdown to Midnight: 6 hourly party-bag tags from 6 pm to 11 pm with an activity for each
• Score sheet and answer keys; elegant midnight navy and gold design

INSIDE
Cover, Bingo (24 cards + caller), Trivia (2 pages), Most Likely To, Would You Rather, Word Scramble, 2027 Predictions, 2026 in Review, Countdown tags, Score sheet, Answer keys.

FILES
2 PDF files (26 pages each): US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and A4.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download instantly from your Etsy Purchases page.
2. Print at 100% / actual size on paper or cardstock. Print only the games you want, as many copies as you need.
3. Cut out the cards and tags on the dashed lines, and keep the answer keys for the host.
